description.default: Discover connections between your notes. Normal uninstall keeps graph data for reinstallation; deleting plugin storage removes it. Export a backup first. Original notes are unaffected.
description.zh-CN: 让笔记片段彼此照见，连接想法，留下思考。普通卸载保留图谱与设置，重新安装可继续使用；手动清理插件数据目录会删除记录。建议卸载前导出备份，笔记原文不受影响。
